title: 今日财经要览：伊朗战争影响全球能源与经济
summary: 本晨新闻聚焦几个关键故事，涵盖油价飙升、美联储决策及亚洲受冲击情况。

sources.title: The Iran Mine Threat Rattling Global Oil
sources.description: Has Iran laid mines across the Strait of Hormuz? With attacks on gas and oil facilities across the Middle East sending energy prices soaring, a key to restoring global oil supplies is ensuring the Strait of Hormuz is safe for tanker traffic. However, even the possibility that the area has been mined suggests that a recovery could be slow. On today’s Big Take podcast, Bloomberg’s global defense editor, Gerry Doyle, tells David Gura about the challenges of clearing mines — especially before the shooting stops. Read more: Mines, Missiles, and the Strait of Hormuz Mine-Sweeping Drones Don’t Eliminate The Risks For Clearing Hormuz Hosted by David Gura; Produced by David Fox; Reported by Gerry Doyle; Edited by Jeffrey Grocott. sources.title: This Is the Fed's Worst Nightmare
sources.description: The Federal Open Market Committee announced this afternoon that it would hold interest rates steady. The decision comes in spite of spiking oil prices and new market uncertainty driven by the Iran War. On today’s Big Take podcast, host David Gura sits down with Bloomberg Federal Reserve reporter Amara Omeokwe and Wharton professor and historian Peter Conti-Brown to discuss how the Fed is thinking about the Iran War and its impacts on the US economy — and what could shift its calculus in the months ahead. Read more: Fed to Hold Interest Rates Steady as Iran War Scrambles the Economic Outlook Hosted by David Gura; Produced by Julia Press; Reported by Amara Omeokwe; Edited by Tracey Samuelson. sources.title: Asia Is Bearing the Brunt of the Iran War Energy Crisis
sources.description: From soaring fuel prices in Pakistan to a shortage of cooking gas in India, Asia is bearing the brunt of the energy crunch sparked by the Iran War. On today’s Big Take Asia podcast we look at how war in the Middle East has pushed Asia to the forefront of a global crisis. Host K. Oanh Ha speaks with Bloomberg’s Faseeh Mangi about the impact of soaring fuel prices in Pakistan and Clara Ferreira Marques about how the least economically resilient countries are feeling the most pain. Hosted by K. Oanh Ha; Produced by Yang Yang, Naomi Ng; Reported by Faseeh Mangi, Clara Ferreira Marques; Edited by Paddy Hirsch. Fact-checking by Naomi Ng, Eleanor Harrison-Dengate; Engineering by Taka Yasuzawa. Senior Producer: Naomi Shavin; Deputy Executive Producer: Julia Weaver; Executive Producer: Nicole Beemsterboer. sources.title: Will Russia Be the Biggest Winner of the Iran War?
sources.description: As the war in Iran draws in more countries, it’s had unlikely benefits for one of Iran’s key allies: Russia. President Trump has eased some sanctions on Russian oil in his efforts to alleviate the oil squeeze created by the conflict. Meanwhile, the allyship between Russia and Iran has deepened as both countries have shared battlefield intelligence. On today’s Big Take podcast, host Sarah Holder talks with US defense and intelligence reporter Natalia Drozdiak about how Russia could benefit from the Iran War — and what it could ultimately mean for Russia’s war in Ukraine. Read more: Putin’s ‘Hidden Hand’ Guides Iran’s Strikes in Widening War Hosted by Sarah Holder; Produced by David Fox; Reported by Natalia Drozdiak; Edited by Naomi Shavin. digest.episode_summary: 本晨新闻聚焦几个关键故事，涵盖油价飙升、美联储决策及亚洲受冲击情况。
digest.lead: 今天的故事围绕着油价上涨、美联储的利率决定以及亚洲如何应对中东战事带来的挑战展开。

stories.headline: 伊朗战争威胁全球油路安全
stories.summary: 由于中东地区对天然气和石油设施的攻击，油价飙升。若伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡布设了水雷，这将如何影响油轮交通的安全？Bloomberg的国防编辑Gerry Doyle与David Gura一起探讨了清除水雷的挑战——尤其是在冲突仍在继续的情况下。
stories.why_it_matters: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球石油运输的关键航道。任何对该区域安全的担忧都可能引发油价波动，进而影响全球经济。

stories.headline: 美联储面临最糟糕的情况
stories.summary: 尽管油价飙升和中东战事带来的市场不确定性，联邦公开市场委员会决定维持利率不变。Bloomberg的联邦储备记者Amara Omeokwe与历史学家Peter Conti-Brown讨论了美联储如何应对伊朗战争及其对美国经济的影响。
stories.why_it_matters: 美联储需要在高通胀和能源危机之间做出平衡决策。伊朗战争可能改变其政策方向，尤其是在未来几个月内。

stories.headline: 亚洲成为全球能源危机的前线
stories.summary: 从巴基斯坦飙升的燃料价格到印度的燃气短缺，中东战事对亚洲产生了严重影响。Bloomberg的Faseeh Mangi与Clara Ferreira Marques讨论了伊朗战争如何影响亚洲。
stories.why_it_matters: 亚洲国家在应对能源危机方面最为脆弱，因此成为全球关注焦点。

stories.headline: 俄罗斯或成伊朗战争的最大赢家
stories.summary: 随着伊朗战争的扩大，俄罗斯与伊朗之间的同盟关系加深。特朗普对俄石油实施了部分制裁以缓解油价压力，而这种盟友关系可能为俄罗斯在乌克兰战争中的行动提供支持。
stories.why_it_matters: 俄罗斯可能利用伊朗战争来增强其在乌克兰战场上的影响力。
